desc: Validate reduction: answer = |Y-Z| + 2*max(0, min(Y,Z) - bottleneck), same-cell -> |Y-Z|; verified on Sample 1.
Implement node-activation offline DSU (descending F order) with small-to-large query-set merging to resolve each cross-cell query's bottleneck M at first-connection weight.
Output |Y-Z| + 2*max(0, min(Y,Z) - M) with fast stdin parsing and joined output buffer.
Handle edge cases: same-cell queries, equal F values, indices/base conversions.
